resources.string: Add AI
Step %1$d of %2$d
Continue
Choose an AI service
Forkcast uses it to estimate meals from a photo or a description. You can change it later.
Gemini, free
By Google. Free, with a daily limit. You need a Google account.
Recommended for most people
Claude, paid
By Anthropic. You pay per use, about $2 a month. You need a credit or debit card.
Advanced: OpenAI-compatible
For experts: OpenAI, OpenRouter or your own server. You enter the server, model and key yourself.
Set up manually
What this means
An API key is like a password that lets Forkcast use your account with %1$s. You create it on their website and paste it here.
What gets sent
Only the meal photos and descriptions you choose to estimate. Never your weight, goals, age or other body data.
Cost
Privacy
Terms
You create a free Gemini API key with your Google account. It takes about 5 minutes.
Free. Google limits how many estimates you get each day, and a normal day of meals fits. If you add billing to the key later, Google charges per use.
With a free key, Google may use what you send to improve its products, and people may review it. Don\'t put anything private in a description.
In the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland, Google\'s terms allow only paid keys: add billing to the key\'s project.
Google\'s terms apply, and you must be 18 or older to use the Gemini API.
Read Google\'s terms
You create an account with Anthropic, the company behind Claude, add some credit with a card, and create an API key. It takes about 10 minutes.
Pay per use from credit you add first: about 1 cent per photo, or around $1.70 a month at 4 photos a day. This is separate from a Claude.ai subscription.
By default, Anthropic doesn\'t use what you send to train its models.
Anthropic\'s terms apply.
Read Anthropic\'s terms
Get your key
Follow these steps on the website, then come back to Forkcast.
I have my key
Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account. If it asks, accept Google\'s terms.
Tap Create API key. If it asks for a project, pick one or let it create one.
Copy the key, then come back to Forkcast.
Open Google AI Studio
Open the Claude Console and sign in, or create an account.
Add credit under Billing. A small amount, like $5, lasts a long time.
Optional: set a monthly spending limit under Limits.
Open API keys and tap Create key. Name it Forkcast, choose a workspace (Default is fine) and set it to never expire.
Copy the key. It starts with sk-ant- and is shown only once. Then come back to Forkcast.
Open the Claude Console
Open Billing
Open Limits
Open API keys
Paste your key
Tap Paste. Forkcast checks the key with %1$s right away.
